title: Bound on the squared hypercontractive radius
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ have $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractivity. Suppose $0<\rho$, the mean of $X$ is zero, and its second moment is one. Then $\rho^2\le 2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ has $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractivity, including its defining exponent, radius, integrability, and norm inequality conditions
The second moment of $X$ is one
